clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, a Rough Quartz comes from a Minor Manifestation of Earth. A shaman brings the stone to an elder, who binds it into the first Earth Totem.

Rough Quartz is a gift from a Minor Manifestation of Earth to a shaman who communes with the spirits in Durotar or Mulgore. To the untrained eye, it looks like an ordinary desert pebble. The stone represents endurance, patience, and unwavering strength. At the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller binds it into carved wood to make an Earth Totem. The quartz becomes the spiritual focus joining a young shaman to Azeroth's living soil.
